desktop-release.windowPosition: offscreen on Windows; measures render/present service time, not visible monitor FPS
desktop-release.note: GPU timers include fence/event completion; capture disabled during timed frames. CPU glyph atlas construction and CPU layers are recorded, not called GPU rasterization.

desktop-long-release.windowPosition: offscreen on Windows; measures render/present service time, not visible monitor FPS
